evidence:
PLURAL / WHOLE-COLLECTION WORDING - every instance found, each graded over the whole collection: (1) gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 'exactly one card for that candidate in Applied' - whole Applied column read. (2) functional hro_add_candidate 'in the order added, and an independent context sees the same order' - all six J1 cards. (3) hro_bulk_move 'Fails if ... only some move'; hro_bulk_all_or_none 'none of the set moves ... Fails if any card of a refused set moves by either route'; hro_bulk_places 'none moves ... Fails if any of the three enters' - all cards of each set, UI and replay; brief instruction.md:3 'all of them or none', rules 'If any card fails, none of them moves'. (4) hro_undo_restores 'Y, W, X back in Applied at their places (Y, W, X, Z, A2) while V stays in Screen' - full stage order, matching rules 'Undo puts every card of that move back'. (5) hro_activity 'every successful board action performed on J1 and J2 before A, by any account used in this review ... each card of every single and multi-card move ... every undo ... filtering to one job shows all of that job's lines and only those' - whole log, both directions of the filter; prompt protocol A repeats the full list (S,M,L,C,B,T,K,R,V). (6) hro_activity_refusals 'none of the refused attempts in this review added a line'. (7) hro_candidate_view 'each candidate's own applications all appear' - Noor has two seeded applications (JOB-PLAT INTERVIEW, JOB-DSGN APPLIED), Tomas has seeded + new J2 card, so 'all' is a real multi-row check. (8) hro_candidate_private 'no response a candidate page receives contains ...' with protocol K 'Capture every request the candidate page makes and inspect every response' including socket/SSE payloads; 'answered with only that candidate's own data'. (9) hro_thread_latest 'most recent 30 ... oldest of them first' and hro_thread_earlier '30 at a time in order ... until none remain' - full paging walk. (10) hro_unread_counts 'rises by exactly two and his total by two' and Mei's count computed from the whole observed sequence. (11) hro_mgr_early_refused / hro_observer_readonly / hro_candidate_no_staff / hro_anonymous 'each refused' over their enumerated lists, each item replayed. (12) hro_restart 'your jobs, card order per stage, notes, messages and activity lines' - whole recorded set. (13) polish hro_pol_session_resume 'both boxes are empty' / 'his reply and note drafts are still there'. No criterion uses every/all/only/exactly wording and then samples a single row.

UNCHANGED GUARDS - legitimate side effects checked: global rule functional/prompt.md:19 'A refused action must not change any card, order, message or note' applies only to refused actions, which have no legitimate side effect; the UI put-back after a refusal is required, not penalised. hro_undo_restores 'V stays in Screen' and hro_undo_once 'Z stays in Screen' guard cards outside the undone move. hro_undo_conflict's control explicitly says a note or a change to another card must not block undo, matching rules 'Adding a note does not count as a change'. Undos, reopenings and re-orderings are expected to add Activity lines (hro_activity), so they are not counted as stray changes. hro_pol_live_thread accepts the view following the new newest message. Golden check: index.js:312 bumps version only for moved cards and index.js:354 blocks undo only on version change of the move's own cards, so the B(12) control (Mei re-orders Y while A2 sits lower in the same Screen column) passes in the golden; a conforming swap-based alternative bumps only Y and W, also fine.

NOTE-LEVEL OBSERVATIONS (sampled universal rules; coverage belongs mostly to row 26 but recorded here because the brief states them universally): (a) hro_move_one_stage tests only a forward skip (Interview to Hired) although rules say 'one stage at a time, forward or back ... Skipping a stage is refused'; no row tests a backward skip (e.g. Offer to Applied), so an app that refuses only forward skips passes. Golden enforces both via Math.abs at index.js:253. (b) hro_undo_conflict tests moved, re-ordered and rejected but not the rules' fourth blocker 'reopened'. (c) Brief 'every staff action are refused to candidates' and Observer 'changes nothing' are sampled with move/add/open-job/note replays; reject/reorder/undo replays by candidate or Observer are not tried. (d) Candidate wording is observed for Application received/In review/Interviewing/Not moving forward but never for Offer/Hired (identity mappings, low risk).

OUT-OF-ROW DEFECT FOUND WHILE CHECKING THE UNDO-CONFLICT GUARD (for the owner to route, likely rows 18/32): protocol B step (14) is infeasible as written in the golden and in any conforming app. Trace with the rules' arrival order: after (7) Screen=V,Y,W,X; (9)-(10) Screen=Y,W,X; (12) Z,A2 arrive -> Y,W,X,Z,A2; Mei re-orders Y (top card, so only Down) -> W,Y,X,Z,A2; undo A2; (13) A2,V arrive -> W,Y,X,Z,A2,V; Applied is empty; (14) Y and W move together in board order -> Applied=W,Y, so 'move W up one place within Applied' is impossible (golden board.js:272 disables Up at index 0). The judge must improvise (W down or Y up - both still re-order a card of the move, and the golden would still refuse the undo) or may record the leg as not exercised and zero hro_undo_conflict (weight 2) for a correct app. No runtime evidence covers this: raw-evidence-index scope says the scripted driver 'does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would' and workspace.cjs uses its own API fixtures for undo.

No configured judge run exists, so whether the judge actually inspects whole collections is NOT EXERCISED.
counterexample: Plausible weak app that passes: validates only forward adjacency (if toIdx > fromIdx + 1 refuse) and lets a card jump back several stages; it passes hro_move_one_stage (Interview->Hired refused) and every other row. Conforming app that may be penalised: any correct app at protocol B step (14), where W is already at the top of Applied so the prescribed 'move W up one place' cannot be performed, risking a NOT EXERCISED zero on hro_undo_conflict.
suggested_fix: Add a backward-skip try (e.g. Offer->Applied, UI or replay) to hro_move_one_stage and a 'reopened' leg to hro_undo_conflict if workload allows; change protocol B step (14) to 'move Y up one place within Applied' (or 'move W down one place').
